facts: Block-level row materialization is lazy, but a width-index miss renders every block to obtain exact heights.
The growing assistant draft is one reuse-never Markdown block.
The 32 ms scheduler coalesces paint requests only after synchronous snapshot projection.
The old live process repaints the layered Astra workspace every 120 ms while execution or decorative motion remains active.
Default virtual viewport reuses a stable off-screen normalized prefix and processes a visible window with overscan.
Monotonic component revisions permit subtree reuse.
Markdown has bounded render, parse, and highlight caches plus streaming throttle and highlight admission caps.
Transcript ownership is explicit as active, settled, and committed.
Finalized semantic rows retire through monotonic acknowledged history batches while only a bounded suffix remains mutable.
Scheduling adapts to previous frame cost and defers ordinary frames under terminal output backlog.
The full component tree renders before terminal line diffing.
Keyboard input can force an immediate frame, but the renderer has no transcript-finality lifecycle of its own.

rankedFollowups: Make the active Markdown block append-aware with a stable completed prefix and mutable suffix.
Coalesce delta-only snapshot publication before projection while preserving immediate lifecycle transitions.
Adopt adaptive frame-cost and pending-output backpressure scheduling.
Introduce active-settled-committed transcript retirement only after resize and scroll-anchor contracts are specified.
causalityBoundary: Live samples correlate high parent CPU with a quiescent working screen and low descendant CPU, but do not directly attribute sampled CPU stacks to a named JavaScript function or observe terminal pixel latency.
